# Upstream source

- Repository: https://github.com/blader/humanizer
- Commit: `225a6f39ac85f76ee48dbad772ea4abe4ed6c9d8`
- Skill version: `3.1.0`
- Source file: `SKILL.md`
- License: [MIT](LICENSE)

`SKILL.md` is copied without content changes as `INSTRUCTIONS.md` so the bundle exposes only `hashiiiii-write-en`.
Humanizer's runtime instructions are self-contained. Its plugin metadata and package validator are not needed by this wrapper.

To update, select an upstream commit and copy its `SKILL.md` as `INSTRUCTIONS.md`, along with its license.
Update the commit and version above. Keep the wrapper constraints and run the installation and writing checks.
